note: Governs the OP-00A relationship graph's own edge vocabulary (scripts/intelligence/lib/relationship-edge-builder-v1.mjs, semantic-relationship-builder-v1.mjs, identity-reconciliation-v1.mjs). Distinct from contracts/intelligence/registries/correlation-relationship-types-v1.json, which governs a separate, narrower vocabulary for harvest-side correlation tagging.

versioning.additive: New types are additive-only and bump registryVersion's minor segment. No superseding plan required.
versioning.redefinition: Forbidden in place. A changed meaning gets a new type id; the old id is marked DEPRECATED, never edited.
versioning.removal: Forbidden. Matches this repo's append-only posture (Gold Mine's never-shrink index, OP-00A's never-delete history). Use status: DEPRECATED instead.

enforcement: scripts/intelligence/lib/schema-validate.mjs#validateRelationshipEdges, called from ingest-pipeline-v1.mjs immediately after buildRelationshipEdges(). An edge whose relationship id is missing or not ACTIVE hard-fails ingest with RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_NOT_REGISTERED.
